evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: MISSING — Rep launches straight into schedule confirmation and estimates with no framing of call structure, time commitment, or quid pro quo promise.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: MISSING — Never asked. Rep moves directly into repeating inventory details already provided via email.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Typically for a one bedroom apartment usually takes two and a half to three and a half hours to complete...I'll just put your move on the three and a half to four and a half hour mark...the minimum cost for this move is $565...estimated budget of $761...around $761 to $900 and $957.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Now, we also include other features like our no worries damage coverage...If we go over, we only charge every fifteen minute intervals...For the clock, it will only start once we arrive at your current apartment...For any move there's just a two and a half hour minimum...we only charge in every fifteen minutes.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: MISSING — No 'does that feel fair?' or equivalent pause check.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: On time guarantee if we run late, we provide discounts by the end of the day.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage: Our no worries damage coverage which would give you up to $2,000 coverage for any accidental damages...no hidden fees of any type...for this move, we will include up to $2,000 coverage for any accident of damages like repair, replacement reimbursement.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Rep does not circle back to confirm Two Promises have been addressed; instead pivots to payment and deposit terms.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Would you like our help work for this move on Sunday?
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Do you have any questions so far? — Closed-ended throwaway, not a genuine concern probe like 'What's still concerning you about this move?'
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: MISSING — No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Arrival window confirmed (11:30 AM–1:30 PM Sunday). Addresses confirmed (14440 Persons Market Circle to 13145 North Highway 183). Phone number NOT confirmed in transcript. Crew size NOT explicitly confirmed. No notes left about customer concerns (bathroom disassembly, mattress protection).

top_strength: Joanna delivered a clear, itemized estimate range ($565–$957) anchored to the home's actual logistics, and fully disclosed both the On-Time Guarantee and $2,000 No Worries Damage Coverage with no-deductible framing.
coaching_note: Start every call with the quid pro quo framing and a real pause for agreement before diving into details; open with 'What else are you concerned about on this move?' before repeating information, and ask 'Does that feel fair?' after pricing to give the customer a moment to react before moving forward.
